item.message: Model metadata for `Qwen/Qwen3.6-27B` not found. Defaulting to fallback metadata; this can degrade performance and cause issues.

item.text:
In `RipgrepLocator.cs:108-110`, `ConfiguredPath` catches these three exception types, each returning `null`:

1. **`JsonException`** — malformed JSON in `.devx/config.json`
2. **`IOException`** — I/O failure reading the config file
3. **`UnauthorizedAccessException`** — permission denied accessing the config file
